_why: Where this run's evidence lives. The authoritative copy is the summary.json in the shared runs directory; this file points at it rather than duplicating it.
name: ctdose-core-ge-validation-arm
reason: Unresolved AI findings remain at medium and low severity. Recorded as FAIL because that is the framework's verdict; POLICY forbids writing it up as a pass.
what_the_review_changed: The headline. The arm reported '+11.6 %, all four within 20 %'. That number rested on a bowtie tie broken by the order of a module-level tuple -- the head filter for a body phantom -- and on a recorded collimation the report's own exposure time refutes. Both were verified locally before any change.

Eligibility. Sequenced (step-and-shoot) acquisitions were excluded as though the table did not move; in CID 10013 it advances between rotations. One admissible event was being lost, and it is the only event in the arm whose recorded geometry its own exposure time corroborates.
DCM 113824, the event total exposure time, was defined in the parser and never read. It is the measurement that independently constrains beam width.

Five successive rules for choosing a tabulated collimation row from that measurement were tried and all five refused, each resting on a number chosen rather than measured. The arm now uses the measurement to refute the recorded width and not to select a replacement, and publishes both defensible readings of what follows.
A stated failure condition, which the arm had none of: the best admissible combination must come within 1 % of the recorded value. It does, to 0.50 % at worst, under either reading.

Neither accuracy arm has an independent reference. The recorded CTDIvol is a console figure and the coefficient table is a survey of console figures from the same factory calibrations (Dinwiddie et al. 2026, sections 2.1-2.2). This is now stated in the manuscript (2.3, 2.7, Limitations), the supplement and both letters; the word 'measured' was removed where the manuscript used it of that table.

Three crashes on paths the five frozen events do not reach: an empty assumption grid reaching the headline, a missing pitch formatted into an exclusion reason, and an incompatible reading read for a percent error.

Roughly a dozen assertions that could not fail, in both the standalone test and the project suite, including one that proved the beam-width argument by comparing two predictions differing by exactly 40/collimation.
residual_findings: Several numeric claims in provenance.what_the_sample_can_discriminate are written by hand and no test re-derives them. Two such figures were found wrong during the session and corrected; the class is not closed.
The eligibility oracle checks counts against rows and reason text against rule text, but does not check each exclusion reason against the excluded event's own recorded fields.
summary.by_model_reported_band is built from the wide reading only; the narrow reading does not appear per model.

The standalone test cannot check the coefficient values, only the grid's keys, because the published table is not in the snapshot. tests/test_ctdi_table.py pins the eighteen GE cells this arm reads, which detects a silent change to the data or the lookup but does not re-verify the extraction.
why_stopped: Twenty rounds. The last several produced no high-severity finding and consisted mostly of documentation lag from the previous round's own edits plus completeness gaps on branches the five frozen events cannot reach. The findings that moved a reported number, or that would have reached JACMP reviewers, were all raised in the first five rounds and are fixed. The residual list above is carried forward rather than closed.

local_verification.standalone_snapshot: 42 tests under python -I, as the framework runs them
local_verification.injection_harness: tools/prove_ge_arm_recompute.py: 20 injected defects, all refused, real result file passes

not_covered_by_this_framework: AI-Check v1 accepts only `unittest discover`, so the project's pytest suite is outside it and is reported here as a separate check rather than claimed as part of this verdict.

tests/test_ge_rdsr_accuracy.py drives exclusion_reason() directly on synthetic events; the three-file snapshot cannot, so eligibility findings needing that were noted in the brief rather than claimed untestable.
The GE sample objects themselves (OpenREM/PixelMed, GPL-3.0) were not sent; only measurements derived from them. Re-parsing them is a local check.
No figure, PDF page or built document was reviewed by the framework.
